Gain visibility and operational agility over your production
Just Plan It is automatic finite scheduling software for job shops and multi-operation manufacturers. Stop improvising every time something changes. Start with a schedule your entire team can trust.
Built for job shop and multi-operation manufacturers, whether that's high-mix, low-volume productions or standard, repeast manufacturing with complex routings.
Managing order priorization, sequencing, machine scheduling and resource allocation.

A rush order comes in, and suddenly the schedule you created is already outdated. Revising it involves significant manual effort, as every change ripples through priorities, capacities, and dependencies at once.
No real transparency in production
You monitor production using incomplete, often outdated information. Current bottlenecks are invisible, order progress is unclear. Your decisions are based on gut feelings rather than facts.

Just Plan It offers automatic finite scheduling based on a visual approach. The scheduling engine maximizes throughput while respecting your finite capacities and order priorities. The result is an interactive Gantt chart your planner can review, trust, and adjust in seconds.
Automatic reprioritization
New orders are automatically prioritized and rescheduled in real time. The visual planning board instantly shows your team the updated situation, including the impact on all other jobs.

Status changes and completed quantities are automatically pulled from the shop floor, compared against the current plan, and used to update the production schedule. Always accurate, without manual intervention.

Import your orders from your ERP system or Excel spreadsheet via our API. View your entire production plan on an interactive planning board. Instantly identify which orders are at risk of delays before problems arise.
The Just Plan It scheduling engine calculates an optimal, finite-capacity plan based on real priorities and constraints. Change anything by drag and drop. The system recalculates instantly.
See what Just Plan It can do for your production.
A scheduling specialist will walk you through Just Plan It with your specific production environment in mind. Personalized, no pressure, 30 minutes.
Made for job shops, not adapted from mass production tools
Increased throughput, fewer missed deadlines, reduced overtime. Just Plan It pays for itself fast, proven with hundreds of customers across five continents.

You sign up for two things. First, the JPI Launch: a one-time onboarding investment. A dedicated Customer Success Manager works with you to understand your production, set up JPI to fit your processes, and build the routines you need to run it confidently on your own.
Access to the JPI Video Academy

You gain full visibility over your jobs and resources. With accurate, actionable information you will increase on-time deliveries, reduce lead times, and improve throughput. The result is more profitable production, without the constant scramble to keep up with changes.
No. JPI offers annual subscriptions that let you cancel at the end of any annual period. If you prefer a longer commitment with discounted rates, just ask.

JPI is a standalone scheduling application. It comes with a standard Excel interface for importing master data and production orders, and for exporting reports. For deeper integration, JPI connects to virtually any SQL-based ERP system (including Microsoft, SAP, Sage, and others) via its built-in API.

Yes. JPI is a cloud-only product with no on-premise installation. This allows us to release updates every quarter and ensure that all customers are always on the latest version, with immediate access to new features.
JPI is hosted on Microsoft Azure, which provides the most comprehensive compliance coverage of any major cloud provider.
